purpose: Separate execution completion and finite rollout completion from scientific validity.

execution_fields.execution_complete: All registered future transitions completed without an execution/reader failure.
execution_fields.finite_rollout_complete: execution_complete plus every registered prediction/error frame is finite.
execution_fields.scientific_status: Independent scientific gate result; raw rollout completion never implies passed.
execution_fields.failure_category: Execution/reader failure category retained from the raw rollout.
execution_fields.first_failure_frame: First execution/reader failure frame retained from the raw rollout.
execution_fields.scientific_failure_category: Optional vNext physical-gate category, kept separate from failure_category.
execution_fields.scientific_first_failure_frame: First vNext physical-gate frame, kept separate from first_failure_frame.

fixed_denominator.rule: All registered future frames remain in the denominator.
fixed_denominator.executed_negative_case: Counts as executed when an autonomous attempt produced a score row, even when scientific_status=failed.
fixed_denominator.missing_case: Does not count as executed; its registered frame denominator receives the existing missing penalty.

finite_wall_penetration.threshold_status: implementation default only; requires explicit release before being a scientific gate
finite_wall_penetration.semantics: Finite triangle intersection of a saved previous-to-predicted chord.
limitations: Does not reconstruct solver substeps or the exact continuous particle path.
Static geometry only; moving geometry is unsupported.
A near-degenerate triangle/determinant is classified by the numerical diagnostic tolerance.

closed_face_domain_exit.threshold_status: caller diagnostic value; no F3 formal declaration
closed_face_domain_exit.semantics: Finite closed-face endpoint outside test with projected point on the registered face.
limitations: Does not infer a runtime solver-domain AABB.
Endpoint classification does not prove a continuous-path crossing.

state_magnitude.reason: No preregistered explosion threshold is available; report finite magnitudes without classifying a scientific failure.
